verdict.gold_reason: Article 31(5) of Directive 2019/944 states that each DSO shall act as a neutral market facilitator in procuring the energy it uses to cover energy losses, under transparent, non-discriminatory and market-based procedures, where it has such a function. The reference answer restates this correctly.
